authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.observation: EED item 71 maps to DXF group 1071 and carries a four-byte integer.

construction: LibreDWG 0.14 generates local R13/R14 controls with values 123456, 0x80000000 and 0x7fffffff, including remapped root, APPID and group handles and one 3D LINE member. LibreDWG JSON readback verifies the four-byte item values; drawings remain outside the repository.
checks: The shared source observer compares each physical 1071 value as its exact unsigned 32-bit bit pattern against the signed typed model.
ASan controls cover signed minimum, maximum and positive values, per-bit frame mutations, truncated bodies, model mutation, destination preservation and corrected retry.

Group, NOD and MLINESTYLE owner dictionaries pass R14 strict and R13 explicit-partial output in ASCII and Binary encodings. An out-of-profile 1040 real continues through the established unqualified partial route.
Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 readback recovers all three signed values and a separate GROUP-to-3D-LINE edge for each dictionary location and source version.
limits: R13 output remains explicit partial; the MLINESTYLE object and native clone semantics remain unqualified.
Only 1071 and the previously admitted EED items are covered by this source profile. Other EED codes, broader source graphs and general format support remain open.
